newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: JSE says Bertrad listing may be terminated.
newsitem.headline: JSE says Bertrad listing may be terminated.

text.p: Bergers Trading Holdings Ltd (Bertrad) listing on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) may be terminated if the company did not submit its annual financial results by the end of October, the exchange said on Thursday.
Bertrad's shares were suspended on the JSE on July 22 1996.

It said in a statement that if the company failed to submit its results by the end of the month, a special meeting of the general committee of the JSE would consider the continued suspension or possible termination of its listing.
